notes.title: Player Customization
notes.content:
[h2][b]Character customization is now available![/b][/h2]

You can look different from your friends in the online game by customizing your characters. Wear all black or patterned. There are many choices available. Now you are free.

notes.title: Multiplayer Co-op Opened
notes.content:
[h2][b]Multiplayer co-op is now available.[/b][/h2]
Explore the island with your friends!
Find secret areas and fight monsters.
